constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES var_hr_companies(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (approved_by) REFERENCES var_hr_user_accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK (pay_basis <> 'hourly'::text OR work_days_per_month IS NOT NULL AND working_hours > 0::numeric)
CHECK (work_days_per_month IS NULL OR work_days_per_month >= 1 AND work_days_per_month <= 31)
FOREIGN KEY (connected_by) REFERENCES var_hr_user_accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (oauth_state_account_id) REFERENCES var_hr_user_accounts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
